acceptanceCriteria: A read-only command emits a machine-readable per-repository setup report with each gap, its evidence and a suggested fix, and writes nothing.
Tests cover a fully set up fixture and one with each gap class.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). Assessing 25 Beamfall repos needed two review agents assembling init/affected/overview output by hand. No verb reports: missing or stale index snapshot, AGENTS/CLAUDE files with no Corvint route, stale host hooks, repositories without a declared gate, and paths ignored only by the global git excludes file (decision 0158). V1-1977's build log records `doctor` as NOT_PRODUCED.
title: Adoption check: one read-only command that reports a repository's Corvint setup gaps (index snapshot, agent-instruction wiring, hooks, ignored-path drift)
